title: Juniper and the Debt
author: Freya Hartwell
blurb: Zephyrine Lockridge, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
